notes.text: Bava Batra calls the inquirer Yose bar Natan. He eventually finds Rav Sheshet in Mechoza.
The parallel gives Rav Asi bar Natan traveling from Nehardea to Mechoza to ask the same question.
Ketubot portrays Sheshet sitting before and serving as emissary for Huna. The full succession and chronological argument belong to Heilprin’s report and require separate historical collation.
